content.short: Merchant Moe is Mantle's primary DEX and liquidity hub featuring the advanced Liquidity Book protocol.
content.description:
Merchant Moe is the cornerstone decentralized exchange and liquidity hub built natively for the Mantle Network. Developed by the expert team behind Trader Joe (LFJ), the platform brings advanced trading technology to Mantle through its unique "Liquidity Book" protocol. This design allows liquidity providers to allocate their capital with extreme precision, significantly increasing fee capture and capital efficiency compared to traditional AMM models. Merchant Moe serves as the central venue for trading ecosystem tokens and bootstrapping new projects.

Powered by the MOE token, the protocol features a sustainable "real yield" model where stakers receive a share of platform fees. By leveraging Mantle's high-speed infrastructure, Merchant Moe delivers a professional-grade trading experience with minimal slippage and sub-second finality. As a vital infrastructure layer for the Mantle decentralized economy, the project is focused on fostering deep liquidity and providing the innovative financial tools needed for the next generation of cross-chain DeFi.
